svg.title: A battle's layers
svg.desc: A battle in Goma Cave as it opens, as the player sees it, comes apart into the four sheets the console stacks to draw it, then closes again. From the back: the battlefield on BG2, a flat picture of the cave tilted into a floor one screen line at a time; the party and the enemies as sprites; the windows on BG0, the party's HP and PP and the message; and in front the arrow that waits for a button, a sprite. BG1, which holds the same cave flat for effects, draws nothing here.
svg.text: A BATTLE, AS THE PLAYER SEES IT
